title: Romantic Getaway to Nova Scotia: A Couple's Guide for 2026
metaDescription: Plan the perfect romantic trip to Nova Scotia. Sunset spots, intimate dining, and unforgettable experiences for couples in love.
excerpt: Nova Scotia sets the stage for romance like nowhere else. From sunset views to intimate dinners, this guide will help you plan the perfect couple's getaway.
author: Travel Editors
content:
There is something about Nova Scotia that captures the imagination of travelers worldwide. For those planning a romantic getaway to Nova Scotia, this guide will show you the best of what awaits. Beyond the postcards and travel brochures lies a destination rich with culture, flavor, and adventure. We have put together everything you need to know — when to go, what to do, where to stay, and how to make the most of every moment — so your journey to Nova Scotia is as seamless as it is memorable.

## Most Romantic Spots

- Sunset viewpoints that offer breathtaking panoramas over Nova Scotia — bring a blanket and a bottle of wine
- Secluded beaches and hidden coves perfect for private moments away from the crowds
- Candlelit restaurants serving the finest local cuisine in intimate, softly lit settings
- Scenic walks through charming neighborhoods and historic streets hand in hand

![Romantic Nova Scotia](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1526940946820-a61d0f92194e?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Romantic Activities

Hot air balloon rides over Nova Scotia provide a magical perspective that you will never forget. Watching the landscape unfold beneath you at sunrise is pure romance.

## Where to Stay

Luxury resorts with private pools and ocean views create the ultimate romantic atmosphere in Nova Scotia. Splurge on a suite with a balcony for breakfast with a view.

## Planning the Perfect Evening

Surprise your partner with a picnic at one of Nova Scotia's scenic spots. Local cheeses, fresh bread, and a sunset view make for an unforgettable evening.
